Self.Wiki: An item pickup. The treasure places the items of its item lots as a pickup at the treasure part, usually a container asset. Taking it awards the lot; a treasure that starts disabled becomes available when something enables it, such as its container opening.

TreasurePartName.Wiki: The part the pickup is placed at, an Asset in retail. With no part, no pickup appears.

ItemLotID.Wiki: The ItemLotParam_map row given by the treasure.

UncommonItemLotID.Wiki: A second item lot read together with the normal one. -1 for none (about half of the treasures).

PickupAnimID.Wiki: The player animation played when taking the pickup, or -1 for the normal one. -1 on every retail treasure.

InChest.Wiki: The kind of treasure, not a bool: 1 on almost every retail treasure (in a container), else 0, 3 or 4. Unknown: 0x42 only applies to kind 1.

StartDisabled.Wiki: If ON, the pickup is placed hidden and can't be taken until something enables it. About half of the retail treasures use it.

Unk42.Wiki: If ON, the treasure also checks Unknown: 0x48, but only when Treasure Kind is 1, Unknown: 0x4A is 4, and a session condition holds. ON for 448 treasures.

Unk43.Wiki: Read by the game. ON for every treasure in the game files.

Unk44.Wiki: A third ID read together with the item lots, often the item lot's family + 500. -1 for none.

Unk48.Wiki: A value used by the Unknown: 0x42 check. -1 for none, else 10 to 320 in steps of 10.

Unk4A.Wiki: Read by the game; must be 4 for the Unknown: 0x42 check. 0 or 4 in the game files.
